patterns.note: Full-width sections with content constrained to a central max-width container, frequently employing two-column layouts for image/text pairings and three-column grids for statistics or feature summaries.
High-impact, bold, and often uppercase sans-serif headings are used to convey urgency and authority, contrasting with a more standard, readable sans-serif for body text.
A high-contrast palette of dark grey/black and white is punctuated by a vibrant yellow-green for primary calls to action and a warm orange for urgent campaign messaging.
A sticky header transitions from transparent to solid white with a subtle shadow upon scroll, while the hero background image exhibits a gentle parallax effect.
A prominent hero section immediately presents a strong mission statement and a direct call to action, often accompanied by an urgent campaign overlay or modal.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that dynamically changes its background from transparent to solid white and adds a subtle drop shadow as the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
A subtle parallax scrolling effect is applied to the hero background image, making it move at a slower rate than the foreground content to create a sense of depth, likely using CSS keyframes.
Calls to action are visually emphasized through the use of high-contrast, vibrant accent colors (yellow-green and orange) against the site's predominantly monochrome palette.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and often uppercase headings (up to ~4-5x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, supported by clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons, while content blocks and images maintain sharp, defined corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with an airy hero section that uses ample negative space, transitioning to a more structured and moderately dense layout for content sections.

standout: The site immediately confronts the user with a bold, urgent call to action and a prominent donation modal, leveraging a high-contrast palette and impactful typography to convey a sense of immediate importance and authority. This direct, no-nonsense approach to fundraising and advocacy sets it apart.
